description: Apply fresh unmarked bedroom remote light presses to the ambient group only. Keep Mistral helper correction independent; never retransmit RF. Manual choices use the ambient profile's existing reset policy.

conditions.alias: Reject other traffic before queue admission
conditions.value_template: {{ trigger is defined and trigger.entity_id == 'event.study_lilygo_lora32_t3_v1_6_1_bedroom_rf_command' and trigger.to_state is not none and trigger.from_state is not none and as_timestamp(trigger.to_state.state, 0) > as_timestamp(trigger.from_state.last_changed, 0) and trigger.to_state.attributes.get('event_type', '') in ['light_off_unmarked', 'light_warm_unmarked', 'light_neutral_unmarked', 'light_cool_unmarked', 'light_brightness_up_unmarked', 'light_brightness_down_unmarked'] }}

actions.alias: Accept only a fresh triggering occurrence
actions.value_template: {{ trigger is defined and trigger.entity_id == 'event.study_lilygo_lora32_t3_v1_6_1_bedroom_rf_command' and trigger.to_state is not none and trigger.from_state is not none and as_timestamp(trigger.to_state.state, 0) > as_timestamp(trigger.from_state.last_changed, 0) }}

actions.alias: Allow only the six physical light observations

sequence.stop: Ambient OFF handled without manual takeover.

actions.alias: Stop ineligible brightness at the parent sequence boundary

variables.target_pct: {% if brightness_command %}{% set current = (ambient_snapshot.brightness | float(0) * 100 / 255) | round(0) | int %}{{ [[current + (10 if event_type == 'light_brightness_up_unmarked' else -10), 1] | max, 100] | min }}{% else %}0{% endif %}

actions.alias: Pause only the tracked ambient bulbs
